Locomotive engineer (train driver) – median **$75,680**; requires 12‑ to 18‑month Federal Railroad Administration training and certification. [3]

Building inspector – median **$72,120**; 6‑ to 12‑month certification and apprenticeship in building codes. [3]

Air traffic controller – **6-month** FAA-approved training; salaries typically hover around **$120,000** in the U.S. [4]

**Real-estate agent** – requires licensing and training; commissions can vary widely and depend on deals closed—**a single sale on a £700,000 property generates significant commission**. [1]
